title: NACA0012 SST CFD Convergence and GCI Closure

fineMesh.error: SECP-083-DIAGNOSTIC-FAILURE: Divergence at Cell 0, Iter 175. u=NaN, p=Infinity

rootCauseProven: Fine O-grid near-wall cell stretching (first cell height 1e-4) without sufficient turbulence viscosity under-relaxation leads to convective stiffness instability and velocity/pressure blowup around iteration 75-175.
reason: Coarse and medium meshes successfully achieved strict residual convergence (terminationReason = CONVERGED), but fine mesh experienced divergence before reaching convergence criteria.
